name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Use the latest Anthropic Claude 3.7 Sonnet as EXCAVA’s core reasoning engine. It’s the strongest general-purpose model available today, and its consistency with prior decisions means we avoid re-testing settled capabilities. The trade-off is cost—Sonnet is expensive—but the 0.5%+ lift in reasoning quality justifies it.

name: Torque
text: Claude 3.7 Sonnet’s cost spike isn’t just hypothetical—it’s a 2x jump that erodes the 0.5% gain unless EXCAVA’s output value scales proportionally. Instead, test Llama 3.3 70B (the working model) with a targeted prompt-engineering sprint; if it hits the same benchmark for 1/5th the cost, the trade-off is settled.
